[[Green dragon|Green dragons]] can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] at level 52 [[combat]] by [[Krystilia]] after partial completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]]. As Krystilia is the only Slayer master to assign green dragons, they must be fought in the [[Wilderness]], and other variants outside the Wilderness do not count. They attack with [[melee]] and [[dragonfire]], thus some protection against it should be considered. Due to their large size, they are usually able to be [[safespot]]ted with [[ranged]] or [[halberd]]-like weapons. As dragons, they are also weak to [[dragonbane]] weapons.

A majority of dragons are above the level 20 line, thus a level 30 teleport such as an [[amulet of glory]] or [[royal seed pod]] is recommended for escaping player killers. A small cluster of three dragons can be found below level 20 Wilderness just west of the [[Dark Warriors' Fortress]], making it ideal for killing with good attention, as the use of a teleport tab is enough to escape any hostile players. The dragons near the [[Lava Maze]] are above level 30 Wilderness, and thus it is not recommended to kill them there.
